data: The properties of electric and magnetic fields in material media allow us to understand polarization and magnetization of materials. These have tremendous applications in the form of microwaves and electromagnets, and are useful in explaining various chemical phenomena. On the theoretical side, the work of Faraday, Maxwell and others laid the foundation for the first major ‘unification’ of forces in the history of physics – the modern theory of electromagnetism. The behaviour of electromagnetic radiation (light) emerges naturally from this theory, giving us the laws of classical optics. The fundamental incompatibility of electromagnetic theory with Newton’s mechanics was what led Einstein to his special theory of relativity.
